mechanism: Per-chunk cost = sum over parcels of exact-geometry work against every bbox-candidate city polygon; ST_Area(ST_Intersection) has no prepared-geometry path so each in-city hit pays a GEOS overlay linear in city vertices, and corridor parcels bbox-hit 3-5 overlapping polygons (Austin 32811 straddling in, Georgetown 11290, Cedar Park 8801, Round Rock 7059). prop_id text order is a geographic transect, so the chunk walk profiles annexation geometry: the stretch is the corridor, not degradation, and chunk 8's fall to 308s plus 3-run per-range reproducibility within 3% proves it.
second_mechanism_rejected: Per-range custom-plan flip on the ungated NOT MATERIALIZED chunk SQL. Range-deterministic, therefore consistent with reproducibility; rejected as primary on five observed per-in-city cost levels (a flip is binary), ~45 flip-free control plans (Hays + McLennan twice), and in-band split tracking. Definitive EXPLAIN at range literals is PENDING-STORE-READ; fix 2 removes the surface regardless.
travis_prediction: Structurally non-terminating under the current design: Austin's ring is a candidate for most parcels, no cheap head, most chunks 20-60 min, 16-40h total against a 6h task timeout with max-retries 0 and run_id-keyed resume.
